card.name: Capital B starting a word
card.fires_on: The letter B (or -B, b) at the start of a word piece, often in all-caps warning text, such as the B in BLOOD, BIRTH, BASED. It also fires on broken byte pieces inside non-Latin script.

modes.label: Capital B in caps warnings
modes.description: A split-off B beginning a word such as BLOOD, BIRTH or BASED in all-capital boxed warnings.
modes.example: WARNING: RISK OF UTERINE RUPTURE, ABORTION, PREMATURE<< B>>IRTH, BIRTH DEFECTS;

modes.label: B after a hyphen or word break
modes.description: A B or b that starts the second half of a hyphenated or joined word.

modes.label: Broken bytes in Lao text
modes.description: A partial character piece inside Lao script.
